title: Multilingual Profile Page

requirements.text: Display name field accepts and preserves any Unicode script (Latin, Japanese, German with umlauts, Arabic) without stripping or mangling characters on save or render
Right-to-left (RTL) support for Arabic profiles: layout, text alignment, cursor behavior switch to RTL, and mixed LTR/RTL lines render with correct bidirectional ordering
Bio field fully supports emoji including multi-codepoint and ZWJ sequences, persisting round-trip without corruption into mojibake
Unicode-safe truncation of display name and bio on grapheme-cluster boundaries (never splitting a character, surrogate pair, or emoji sequence), appending an ellipsis

known_issues: heavy non-English text (Japanese, German, Arabic) and emoji embedded directly in the requirements; tests UTF-8 encoding robustness of the parser
hallucination_traps: must not drop, transliterate, or garble the non-ASCII requirement text
must not treat emoji or foreign-language sentences as noise to be ignored
notes: This is a genuine, well-formed PRD. Parser should decompose the four real requirements faithfully and preserve non-ASCII content.
